title: Settings › Help & about: the What's new box is as tall as short release notes and caps long ones at 150 px so they scroll
steps: S1: Run the Help & about render and model suite of packages/ui/tracy-settings.
expect: S1: notesBoxHeight answers null (no fixed height) for notes up to 150 px tall, 150 for longer ones, and 150 when nothing was measured yet; the rest of the Help & about suite stays green.
fence: The height rule is a pure function tested in process; the measured box in a real window is checked once on dev in the acceptance app.

tests: the notes box fits short notes and caps long ones so they scroll
What’s new shows only with a waiting version and notes
